name: Ducol Organics & Colours Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1924, Ducol Organics 
& Colours Ltd offers a range of pigment dispersions for various industries[1]
keyPoints:
Business overview:[1]
DOCL manufactures dispersions, preparations, concentrates, emulsions, 
pastes, colorants, elaborations, master batches and tinters

cons: Stock is trading at 3.15 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 3.65% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 8.03% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.3.15 Cr.
